statement: The complete certificate relation transports under admitted carrier isomorphisms and color permutations with the reference and finite region retained.
admitted_carrier_maps: The mathematical unrefined D3 carrier: g(v)=Q*v+b for a signed coordinate permutation Q and b in D3. A bijection of the finite color alphabet is transported too.
instance_extension: Colored region z+L_N, z in D3, with all template coordinates kept global; optional explicit reference point, label and optional nonzero lattice direction.
transport: S'=Q*S+b; z'=Q*z+b; a'=Q*a+(1-m)*b; m'=m; q'=palette(q); reference points move by g and directions by Q only.
native_comparison: All 48 matrices preserve unrefined macrogeometry. The actual source's fixed octahedral diagonal is along the y axis, so only 16 preserve its primitive subdivision; test both macro and primitive neighbor routines without asserting full particle covariance.
acceptance: Written forward/inverse/identity/composition laws for whole certificate records and references; independent old-verifier checks after correct recentering; exhaustive declared finite group controls; actual source macro/primitive comparisons; reject naive offset/reference/direction/region transport.
falsifier: An admitted macro map loses certificate validity or full context, inverse/composition laws fail, or source primitive covariance is claimed where the fixed subdivision changes.
scope_boundary: No reference-free unique witness selector, native PN/NE or coefficient-frame covariance, physical evolution, or root closure. The full-48 certificate symmetry is not a full-48 native primitive symmetry.
